notes: AWS AI Service Card PDF (18 pages; printed footers 1–15). Used PDF linked from the seed web URL. Seed lists only this document. Numeric results are scarce: BOLD 99.9% across all four models, Premier 95.3% on proprietary bias prompts, and a non-exact 'over 90%' harmlessness average (kept as finding; not in evalResults). Named capability/safety benchmarks (WMDP, Cybench, StrongReject, etc.) have no scores. Frontier 'within the tolerance threshold' mapped to level below for Premier only. Context window described without a token count. knowledgeCutoff left not_stated despite text saying no cutoff date is defined.
